question: Which Indian origin Sikh has been given New South Wales Australian of the Year award 2023 for supporting the community affected by floods, bushfires, drought and Covid-19?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amar Singh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amar Singh**, an** Indian-origin Sikh** volunteer, has been honoured with the **prestigious 2023 New South Wales Australian of the Year Award** for supporting the community **during floods, bushfires, drought and the pandemic.**
 
• He was honoured with the **2023 New South Wales Australian** of the Year Award in the **category of “Local Hero”.**
 
• He was recognized for his contribution to **supporting the community during drought, floods, COVID-19 pandemic and bushfires.**
 
• The New South Wales Australian of the Year Award is a prestigious recognition bestowed upon individuals who have made** outstanding contributions to their respective fields and have positively impacted the community.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Navjit Kaur Brar**

 
 
• Navjit Kaur Brar is an** Indo-Canadian health care worker** who has become the **first turban-wearing Sikh woman to be elected as a city councillor of Brampton city in Canada. **
 
• Brar is a **respiratory therapist** and won the race in **Wards 2 and 5** in the municipal council polls in **Brampton City.**
 
 
 
• **Jatinder Singh**
 
 
• Jatinder Singh is a **cricketer** who plays for the **Oman national cricket team.**
 
• He was born on **March 5, 1989, in Ludhiana, Punjab, India.**
 
• Jatinder Singh was recently** in the news for being held in a Hawala case **after nine days on the run. 
 
• He was a minister in the** Mufti Sayeed-led coalition government.**
